facts.fact: Several suspects were arrested at the Pole national de lutte contre la cybercriminalite over fraudulent use of NINA data to register SIM cards, per the ministry as reported; no law or offence is named.
facts.system: Pole national de lutte contre la cybercriminalite

facts.fact: The Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) acted on complaints and denunciations of personal data violations over NINA misuse on SIM cards and called it a massive compromise of personal data.
The APDP, the personal data protection authority, was seized of complaints and alerted individuals and operators to data violation risks in August 2025.
The APDP issued warnings to individuals and operators, saying publishing the NINA data on social networks is itself a violation, with no decision or sanction stated.

facts.fact: Telecom operators identify SIM card subscribers with their NINA data, and the regulator AMRTP instructed all licensed operators to give subscribers a means to check the phone numbers linked to their NINA, after fraudulent registrations came to light.
